title: Dominic and the Bell
author: Edmund Okonkwo
blurb: Vesper Nakamura, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
